categories.main_business_segments: FP Corporation (FPコーポレーション) operates a single main business segment: the manufacturing and sale of disposable food containers, primarily made from synthetic resins. The group also engages in the sale of packaging materials and equipment, recycling of used containers and PET bottles, and related logistics and distribution services. The business is supported by a network of 29 consolidated subsidiaries and one equity-method affiliate, with activities spanning manufacturing, sales, recycling, and logistics.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company’s core technologies include advanced extrusion and molding of synthetic resin sheets (polystyrene, PET, polypropylene), high-precision forming, and proprietary recycling systems such as 'Tray-to-Tray' and 'Bottle-to-Tray' closed-loop recycling. FP Corporation is a leader in lightweighting, functional material development (e.g., high-rigidity biaxially oriented polypropylene sheets), and automation in both production and logistics, including the use of industrial robots and automated guided vehicles.
categories.primary_customers_markets: FP Corporation primarily serves supermarkets, convenience stores, food processors, and wholesalers in the food retail and ready-to-eat (takeout, deli, bento) markets. Its products are widely used in the prepared foods, fresh foods, frozen foods, and institutional meal sectors, including hospitals and care facilities. The company also supplies packaging materials and containers to food-related businesses and packaging distributors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s operations are concentrated in Japan, which accounts for over 90% of sales and assets, with a nationwide production and logistics network covering all major regions. Internationally, FP Corporation has a presence in Southeast Asia through its equity-method affiliate in Malaysia (Lee Soon Seng Plastic Industries Sdn. Bhd.), and is expanding its overseas business in response to customer globalization.
categories.supply_chain_position: FP Corporation operates primarily as a midstream and downstream player in the supply chain, manufacturing food containers from raw materials (including recycled materials) and supplying them directly to retailers, food processors, and packaging distributors. The company is vertically integrated, handling recycling, production, logistics, and sales, and is increasingly involved in upstream activities through recycling of used containers and PET bottles.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing environmental sustainability (carbon neutrality by 2050), expanding closed-loop recycling, developing lightweight and functional materials, and automating production and logistics. R&D focuses on new eco-friendly materials, high-performance containers, and technologies that address labor shortages and productivity needs in the food industry. The company is also investing in renewable energy and digital transformation to enhance supply chain efficiency.
categories.revenue_model: FP Corporation generates revenue primarily through the sale of manufactured food containers and packaging materials to food retailers, wholesalers, and food processors. Additional revenue streams include the sale of recycled materials, packaging equipment, and logistics services. The company also operates e-commerce and catalog sales channels for packaging materials.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: FP Corporation is the leading company in Japan’s disposable food container industry, recognized for its scale, product breadth, and environmental initiatives. Major competitors include Sekisui Plastics, Rengo, and other packaging manufacturers, but FP Corporation differentiates itself through its integrated recycling systems and high market share in eco-friendly containers. The company is regarded as an industry innovator and sustainability leader.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ended March 2025, FP Corporation reported consolidated net sales of 235.6 billion yen and net income attributable to parent company shareholders of 12.5 billion yen, with total assets of 292.2 billion yen and over 5,200 employees. The company has demonstrated steady growth, with a 6.1% year-on-year increase in sales and a 6.5% increase in net income, and targets further growth to 300 billion yen in sales and 30 billion yen in recurring profit in the medium term.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: FP Corporation’s value proposition centers on providing high-quality, environmentally responsible food containers with advanced functionality (lightweight, heat/cold resistance, design), reliable nationwide supply, and strong support for customer productivity and sustainability goals. Its unique closed-loop recycling systems ('Tray-to-Tray', 'Bottle-to-Tray'), extensive product lineup, and ability to deliver tailored solutions for labor-saving and logistics efficiency set it apart from competitors.
